intro.zh: 同机新旧配方复核：交换卡组、独立起服，比较 8K/512 单流性能。
intro.en: Same-host comparison of old and new recipes, swapping card assignments across independent server starts for 8K/512 single-stream traffic.

note.zh: 每配方 4 次独立起服、各 32 条请求；32 条窗口不报尾部 SLO。新旧配方同时有多项差异，收益不能归因于单个因素。
note.en: Each recipe has four independent starts with 32 requests per start; 32-request windows do not support tail SLOs. Multiple recipe changes prevent attribution to one factor.

intro.en: Representative measured points from the report; C denotes client concurrency.

notes.zh: 正式窗口冷前缀命中为 0。新配方相对旧配方单流 Decode 高 11.34%、整窗输出吞吐高 10.24%，属于完整配方收益。
notes.en: Measured windows had zero cold-prefix hits. The new recipe improved single-stream decode by 11.34% and aggregate output by 10.24% versus the old recipe; these are whole-recipe effects.
